description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa positioned in the central living zone facing the dining and kitchen area, oriented along the length of the open-plan space.. Dining table (4 seats). Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via through living, walk-in wardrobe (enclosed with door). Master bedroom is only accessible through the living room — no direct corridor access, least private position. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Bathroom accessed directly from the living area — no private corridor. Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children (only one bedroom); flatmates needing private separate bedrooms; those needing a dedicated home office or desk space; wheelchair users (tight bathroom and turning paths).
